description: The pinned Dawn release (RFC 0029 decisions 3, 5 and 11). Its Linux build supplies the WGSL translator (bin/tint), which tools/render/shader_artifacts.py wgsl_compile runs on every core program and suite fixture at build time, and the native webgpu.h implementation (lib64/libwebgpu_dawn.a) that the native lane (tools/render/webgpu_lane.py) links the render.device.webgpu adapter and its suite against. The emdawnwebgpu package of the same release is the browser's webgpu.h for Emscripten builds (RFC 0029 W0); the adapter is written against the core webgpu.h both share. tools/render/shader_toolchain.py webgpu_release owns fetching, sha256 verification and extraction into dependencies/webgpu/<directory>. No other translator is pinned: SPIRV-Cross stays the translator for every other format (RFC 0029 decision 5).
